name: Two lives, explosion and restart
description: The first collision costs one life, the second shows the explosion before the result.
steps: Open the game and click STARTEN.

Hit an obstacle without jumping. Check that Leben shows 1 and the game continues. During the brief flashing protection another overlap must not cost a life. Hit another obstacle after the protection ends, observe the explosion and wait for GAME OVER.
Click NOCHMAL SPIELEN.
expected: Score increases during play. Collision visibly breaks the character into glowing pieces before the result appears. Restart hides the result and starts with two lives, a fresh score and zero coins.

name: Nine original character themes
covers: legal notice with Tailwind MIT terms
description: Each character starts a round with its own world and independently drawn visuals.
steps: Confirm Veylumen appears as the title. Open Menü and expand Lizenzen und Rechtliches to read the complete Tailwind CSS MIT notice.

For each choice Blau, Rot, Blitz, Feuer, Ninja, Prisma, Schattenkern, Kämpfer and Heli, select the character, start a round and observe the figure and its first obstacle. After a collision choose the next character.
Check each world in Schwach and Maximal: observe the sky, grid and the colors of later spikes and hovering hazards.
expected: All nine choices work. Prisma is a turquoise faceted machine core with no hair or clothes. Schattenkern is a dark featureless shadow with a visible pulsing indigo aura, no skull, face or staff. Its monolith is plain, without a symbol. Existing pickups and weapon bonuses still work. Each character has a distinct dark world with visible hazards in its color family. Fire water and red ice retain their recognizable colors with character color highlights. The title reads Veylumen and the MIT copyright and permission terms are available before starting.

name: Mobile jump limit and colored effects
covers: road shadows and moving lane marks
description: Touch controls keep the square character in view and enforce the air jump limit.
steps: Select Kämpfer and start.
Watch the character on the ground and in the air: no extra hands or feet are drawn. Select Heli in another round to see it hover.
Lightly tap the playfield once and check that one jump occurs immediately. Tap again after a brief pause, then tap twice more while airborne, followed by a fifth tap.
Let the character land or restart after collision, then jump again.
Check the road beneath the character while running and jumping: the curb remains directly beneath the runner and the lane marks move across the asphalt.
expected: A light tap makes the fighter jump immediately and only once, with silver white jump particles and visible fire dagger sparks. A fifth airborne tap adds no extra jump. Landing resets the jump allowance. Controls fit the mobile screen. The characters have no added hands or feet, and the flowing trail and scrolling road convey motion; Heli hovers. Collision and jump control remain unchanged. The street has a solid darker surface, a curb under the character, a moving lane and a small shadow below the character.

name: Coins, fire dagger bonus and magnet
description: Collectibles give visible feedback and temporary bonuses during a normal run.
steps: Select Kämpfer, start and use repeated jumps to survive and collect gold coins. Retry after a loss if needed.
Collect the rotating weapon pickup by jumping into it. Touch an obstacle while the weapon is active.
Continue until the weapon expires. Collect a magnet and observe nearby coins moving toward the fighter, then the attraction stopping when the effect expires.
expected: Collected coins increase the coin counter and score. The fighter carries a flaming dagger separated from the body with a small sheath. The weapon bonus shows two orbiting fire daggers and destroys obstacles for bonus points while active. Its expiration removes the orbiting weapons. The magnet temporarily attracts nearby coins.

name: Samurai warning and sword attack
description: A nearby samurai visibly warns and attacks; the player can jump over its blade.
steps: Select Ninja and start. Let the first samurai approach without jumping. Observe its warning, sword swing and short lunge, followed by the collision explosion.
Restart and use Space or ArrowUp to jump over the approaching samurai.
expected: The samurai raises a warning before swinging and lunging nearby. A hit causes the visible explosion and delayed result. A jump above the enemy and sword avoids that attack.

name: Graphics menu and smooth mobile play
covers: menu at top left before game
description: Graphics settings stay in the start and result menu while all play modes retain fluid animation.
steps: Open the game on a phone and open Menü at the top left. Set Grafikqualität to Schwach.
Start a round and observe the player moving smoothly without a settings control over the field.
After Game Over open Menü again, select Maximal and restart. Reload to verify the last choice persists.
expected: All three graphics choices appear in the menu before play and after Game Over. The menu is hidden while playing. Schwach retains smooth movement and simplified effects. Maximal adds a gradient and small stars without rectangular background blocks. The selection persists after reload.

name: Obstacle variety and progressive challenge
description: The runner introduces new hazards and later combines them into avoidable sequences.
steps: Start a round and observe the first themed obstacles.
Keep playing for several seconds and watch for low spikes and hovering hazards.
Continue into later play and watch for two obstacles in a short sequence. Jump over ground hazards or run beneath hovering hazards.
expected: The first moments allow practice. Low spikes and flying hazards appear soon, with paired hazards later. The themed opponent still appears for the selected character. A path through each sequence remains reachable with four jumps.
